part.text: 已获取所有映射信息。现在执行SQL查询，找到2013年SME客户的燃气消耗峰值月份。

input.sql:
SELECT 
  SUBSTR(ym.Date, 5, 2) AS Month,
  SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(ym.Date, 5, 2)
ORDER BY TotalConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1
